verdict.rationale: Firebase's auth docs say that upgrading to Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform adds multi-factor authentication, SAML and generic OpenID Connect support, and multi-tenancy. So MFA and enterprise SSO are the product's own capability, but only on the upgraded tier. The evidence is one short feature-list mention that never shows these can be *required* (enforced) for all application users, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: documentation of MFA enforcement or policy configuration, SAML/OIDC setup depth, availability without the Identity Platform upgrade, independent or hands-on corroboration.
